title: Fix numeric task references in overlap search
body:
## Summary

Numeric task-card references previously matched digits inside unrelated kappa values and commit hashes. Those hits could hide a genuine successor below the result limit.

```diff
 --task supplier-boundary-audit, card term 2977
- match 0.00129771234 and a2977b
+ match #2977, PR2977 and /pull/2977
```

Explicit positional queries remain literal and override card matching for the same number. Leading-zero word terms such as `01021323` stay literal. Reports expose `reference_terms`, and scoring/excerpts use the actual reference occurrence.

This is a scoped coordination-tool repair on canonical main `836b19bfa309ceafbc8ee32a15e8c4b10dde7e11`, priority revision 6. [Evidence, task-selection delta, commands and limitations](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0bc34c304441740273e30e06cb28710bdd3d788d/docs/research/overlap-task-reference-matching.md). [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3001).

## Evidence

- Before: the public CLI fixture returned 22 matches, with 21 decimal/hash hits hiding the genuine PR2977 successor below the default limit. The new tests reproduced the failure on the base script.
- After: that fixture returns only the genuine successor. The same dated live/local corpus reduced numeric-reference hits from 23 to six, removing 17 numeric/hash fragments. That cache observation is not a frozen remote-corpus certificate.
- Python 3.12 warnings-as-errors workflow suite: 164 tests, 18 existing skips. All 25 focused overlap tests pass under optimized Python. Ruff 0.14.1 correctness checks, whitespace checks and selected source-binding orientation pass. A separate read-only review found no blocking issue and caught the leading-zero witness distinction before publication.

Credit Douglas Colkitt for the overlap helper and coordination workflow. The scope refinement followed the existing PR2977/Arham Tahir PR2992 handoff; no predecessor mathematical result is claimed here. Substantial AI assistance was used for implementation, verification and documentation. No independent human review is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. Reverting restores the previous query behavior.

**Blast Radius:** coordination. Only automatically added canonical positive integer overlap terms change matching. Text terms, explicit literal queries, cached coverage, path search and source fetching keep their contracts. Identifier matching remains a syntactic lead filter; broad terms can still fill the result limit. No supplier admission, selected-frontier change or scientific replay is claimed.
